runners_data.name: Baldomero
runners_data.note: Veteran prominent runner whose trainer has dismal recent record (0/23), needs to bounce back from poor recent efforts

runners_data.name: Rogue Enforcer

races.paceDynamic: Democracy Dilemma will lead uncontested from the gates with minimal early pressure, as the prominent runners (Regal Envoy, Rhythm N Hooves, All Ways Glamorous, Marty Hopkirk, Baldomero, Rogue Enforcer) are unlikely to challenge for the early lead over this minimum trip. The sustainable pace will allow the leader to dictate terms into the final furlong, while the hold-up horses (Gaeli, Redorange, Adrestia, Desert Cop) face the difficult task of making up significant ground in the closing stages. With one uncontested leader and good going conditions favouring sustained speed, this race setup strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can track the pace and finish closest.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Democracy Dilemma breaks cleanly and faces no early pressure from the prominent pack
scenarios.body: The leader dictates comfortable fractions and has enough left to repel late challenges, similar to his recent Goodwood win. The prominent trackers battle for the places but cannot reel in the pacesetter.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can sit perfectly behind Democracy Dilemma and time their challenge
scenarios.body: Regal Envoy or All Ways Glamorous track the leader throughout before delivering a well-timed strike in the final furlong when the pacesetter begins to tire. Their tactical speed and reduced weight prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes overly strong with multiple horses pressing Democracy Dilemma
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in the final furlong allowing Adrestia or Redorange to unleash their finishing kicks from the rear. Their class and turn of foot overwhelms the tiring pace-setters.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Backfires
scenarios.trigger: If Rhythm N Hooves or another prominent runner decides to challenge Democracy Dilemma early
scenarios.body: A genuine pace battle develops between two or more speed horses, setting up the race for a closer like Gaeli to sweep past tired leaders. The early duel proves costly for all involved.

watchPoints.text: Democracy Dilemma's break from the stalls is crucial - any tardiness could allow prominent runners to challenge his preferred front-running position
Monitor if Rhythm N Hooves or other prominent runners decide to press Democracy Dilemma early, as this could set up a genuine pace battle
Watch for Redorange's tongue-tie debut and whether the headgear change helps him settle better in the early stages
Adrestia's lengthy 239-day absence needs close scrutiny for any signs of ring-rustiness in the preliminaries
Track whether the hold-up horses (Gaeli, Desert Cop) can get into good early positions, as they'll need to be handy over this minimum trip

races.paceDynamic: Withtearsinmyeyes, Tahalel, and Rajwaah will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with Withtearsinmyeyes likely to lead having shown prominent tendencies in recent runs. The sustained pace over a mile on Good going will test stamina reserves, particularly as these three confirmed front-runners are unlikely to back down. With limited early speed elsewhere in the field, the pace will be honest throughout rather than stop-start. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and those with proven stamina who can finish strongly off the searching gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Favours Closers
scenarios.trigger: If all three front-runners go forward and maintain a strong gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will find out the early leaders in the final furlong, allowing closers with stamina to sweep past tired leaders. Hold-up horses like Trelissick and Zeriya get the perfect setup to unleash late runs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Withtearsinmyeyes gets an uncontested lead with the other pace-setters settling behind
scenarios.body: With her superior RPR of 95 and recent good form, she could dictate terms and kick clear when the others come under pressure. Her stamina has been tested positively over similar trips.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses early with front-runners going too slow initially
scenarios.body: Chimes Of Thunder and Cap Santa Lucia can position prominently and strike when the pace lifts, getting first run on the hold-up horses. Their tactical speed gives them an edge if the race becomes more tactical.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Quisana shows exceptional ability on debut with her blue-blooded pedigree
scenarios.body: The strong pace would suit a horse with natural class stepping up from home, though this requires significant improvement from an unknown quantity. The breeding suggests stamina and class.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Withtearsinmyeyes gets an uncontested lead as her RPR 95 could prove decisive with tactical advantage
Monitor early pace development between the three confirmed leaders as a slow start changes the entire race dynamic
Track Quisana's market moves and paddock appearance as debut runners with this pedigree can be well-backed if ready
Observe Trelissick's early positioning as Hutchinson needs to get her settled for the expected strong pace finish
Check Chimes Of Thunder's jumping from stalls as her prominent style requires good early positioning under Marquand

races.paceDynamic: The Flying Seagull is the only confirmed front runner and will likely dictate terms from the front without serious early pressure. Isle Of Lismore, Rogue Bullet, Jax Edge, Kiss And Run, General Assembly and Sarafina Mshairi can all race prominently but most prefer to sit just off the pace rather than lead. The mid-race tempo should be sustainable with The Flying Seagull controlling things, before the prominent racers and hold-up horses launch their challenges in the final two furlongs. This pace scenario strongly favours prominent racers who can track the leader and have the tactical speed to strike, while hold-up horses may struggle if the pace becomes too steady.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Trackers
scenarios.trigger: If The Flying Seagull sets a manageable tempo without early pressure
scenarios.body: The prominent racers get an ideal tow into the race and can use their tactical speed to strike approaching the final furlong. Hold-up horses find themselves with too much ground to make up when the pace quickens.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If The Flying Seagull gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows the leader to save energy for a sustained drive to the line. Late closers struggle to reel in a horse that's had such an easy time of things.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Finish From Hold-Up
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes crawling slow with multiple prominent horses refusing to commit
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole which suits horses with a devastating turn of foot. Patient jockeys on hold-up horses can unleash late runs that sweep up the field.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent horses challenge The Flying Seagull early creating a fast tempo
scenarios.body: The strong early gallop sets up a war of attrition where stamina and class tell in the closing stages. Mid-division horses who avoid the early battles can pick up the pieces.

watchPoints.text: Watch The Flying Seagull's early tempo - if allowed to coast he becomes very dangerous but any early pressure could compromise his finishing kick
Monitor how Isle Of Lismore handles the return from 314 days off as Saffie Osborne will need her sharp to overcome ring-rustiness
Keep an eye on the hold-up horses if the early pace is too steady - Shavkat and Al Barez particularly need a strong tempo to be effective
Watch for Rogue Bullet to track The Flying Seagull closely given his excellent recent form and preference for this trip

races.paceDynamic: Sir Griflet is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate proceedings from the start, likely getting an uncontested lead over this extended distance. King Of Berkshire and Grey Sands will track prominently but neither is aggressive enough to challenge Sir Griflet's early supremacy. The three hold-up horses (Oh Yes You Do, Morbeh, Any Which Way) will be patient in the rear, relying on their finishing kicks. This sustainable pace setup strongly favours the prominent runners who can track the lone leader and the hold-up horses who get the galloping finish they need.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Sir Griflet sets a steady gallop and the prominent horses fail to bridge effectively
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up trio get the perfect scenario with a true-run race and weak pace pressure allowing their superior class to tell. Oh Yes You Do, Morbeh and Any Which Way can all unleash devastating finishing kicks when it matters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runners strike
scenarios.trigger: If King Of Berkshire or Grey Sands track Sir Griflet perfectly and kick at the right moment
scenarios.body: The horses sitting in the perfect stalking positions can time their move to perfection, getting first run on the weakening leader while the hold-up horses are still making ground. King Of Berkshire's progressive profile and Grey Sands' recent win suggest they can capitalize.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sir Griflet stays on
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely slow and Sir Griflet has enough left in the tank
scenarios.body: The leader's light weight and lack of early pressure allows him to maintain his advantage to the line despite his moderate recent form. His running style gives him every chance if he can find improvement.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Wardlaw springs surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the long absence has freshened Wardlaw and he shows marked improvement from his juvenile runs
scenarios.body: The Prescott-trained gelding benefits from the strong pace and his RPR progression suggests untapped potential on handicap debut. His prominent style suits if he's ready to strike.

watchPoints.text: Sir Griflet could get too easy a lead if the prominent horses are slow to take him on early

races.paceDynamic: Son Of Man looks the only confirmed front runner in this field and should get an easy lead with Due To Henry, Naval Command and Siouxfonic likely to settle prominently behind him. The pace will be sustainable rather than frantic, allowing the leaders to dictate terms through the middle stages of this 1m3½f trip. With hold-up horses Wisper, Sir William and Charlie's Choice needing to come from off the pace, they'll require the tempo to quicken sufficiently in the straight to reel in the front division. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed who can position close to the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Son Of Man gets soft fractions on the front end without pressure
scenarios.body: The front runner controls the race from pillar to post and kicks clear when asked, with the prominent runners filling the placings behind him. Hold-up horses find the sustained pace too much to peg back over this stamina-testing trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early tempo is too slow and the race becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the field to bunch up entering the straight, turning it into a dash where class and finishing kick matter most. This plays into the hands of the higher-rated hold-up horses with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge Son Of Man for the early lead
scenarios.body: The increased pace pressure creates a true test of stamina where the most genuine stayer prevails from a forward position. The early battle softens up the leaders for a closer with tactical pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Long Range Hold-Up
scenarios.trigger: If Wisper or Sir William get perfect runs from the back
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses time their challenges to perfection, sweeping past a strung-out field in the final furlong with superior finishing speed. This requires everything to fall right for the back-markers.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Son Of Man gets unopposed early fractions - could prove unstoppable if allowed soft lead

Observe Siouxfonic's response to first-time cheekpieces in early stages for any positive headgear effect
Check Naval Command's fitness levels after 331-day absence - may need race despite retaining clear ability
Watch Sir William's positioning - needs to be closer than usual given sustainable pace likely

races.paceDynamic: Nzuri will lead unchallenged early, setting a sustainable pace over this sharp 6f. Five horses (My Dad Tom, Yachtsman, Chelio, Rosieisme Darling, Arvana Belle, Stolen) want prominent positions, creating a wall of traffic behind Nzuri that will compress and cause interference from 2f out. The hold-up horses (Madman, Corniche Girl, Marra Donna, Cape Toronada, Zoulette) face a nightmare scenario trying to weave through this congestion in the final 2f. This race shape strongly favours the early leaders and prominent racers who can secure clean runs, while punishing hold-up horses who will meet solid walls of traffic when needing racing room.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack stays clear of major interference and one finds the rail
scenarios.body: The winner emerges from the quintet of prominent runners who avoid the worst traffic, benefiting from a perfect stalking position behind sustainable pace. Hold-up horses get buried in the scrum and never land a blow.

scenarios.body: Despite his fading tendency, Nzuri capitalizes on the chaos behind as prominent runners impede each other in a messy finish. The leader's uncontested early sections prove decisive when followers meet trouble.

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion creates gaps that allow one hold-up horse to thread between rivals
scenarios.body: A patient hold-up horse finds the perfect seam through the traffic jam, with superior finishing kick proving decisive. This requires expert timing and a slice of luck from the jockey.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Nzuri stops abruptly and the prominent pack bunches severely in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The early pace advantage evaporates as tired leaders get swamped, but the finish remains messy with multiple horses arriving together. Form and class become secondary to racing luck.
